primary.bootstrap_design: Cross five training seeds with contiguous 64-window blocks independently resampled within each fixed test capture; the same block draw is shared across methods and seeds. Each capture has fixed equal weight. Recompute exact tie-aware weighted AP; jointly reject draws with no positive flow in any capture.
primary.uncertainty_scope: Conditional on three fixed held-out captures, fixed training data and the selected verified labels. Captures, unseen organizations and unknown background labels are not population-resampled.

audit.calibration_policy: Retain raw scores for AP/AUC/Brier parity; clip to[0,1] only for reliability display and bin membership. Regenerated from raw to include every prediction.
